Package bakerydms

Class BakeryApp

  • java.lang.Object
    • bakerydms.BakeryApp
  • public class BakeryApp
extends java.lang.Object
    Starts the Bakery Order Management System.

    This is the program's entry point. main(String[]) creates a BakeryApp, and start() wires the three layers together:

    1. an OrderValidator with the four cake types the bakery sells,
    2. an OrderManager (business logic) using a 7% sales tax rate,
    3. a DatabaseConnector (data layer), and
    4. the BakeryOrderWindow (presentation layer), opened on the Swing thread.
    The program starts with no database connected; the user enters their MySQL details in the window. It also installs a last-resort error handler, so an unexpected error is shown in a message box instead of closing the program.
    Version:
    4.0 (Phase 4, Module 11)
    Author:
    Kayla Ewing
